FROM OUR FAMILY TO YOUR TABLE

More than a recipe.
A way of life.

It began in 1916, with Lala Kesar Mal Ji and his wife in Sheikhupura. A humble kitchen, an honest meal and a love for Punjabi food.

When the family made Amritsar their home during Partition, the recipes came with them. Today, that same spirit lives in every pot, every prantha and every warm welcome.

BEFORE YOU FOLLOW THE LANES

A little planning.

Everything for your visit ↗
Where will I find the original?+

Visit us at Chowk Passian, Gali Rajpura, near Telephone Exchange in Amritsar. Kesar Da Dhaba has no other branches.

When can I visit?+

Our published hours are 12 noon to 11 pm. We close on the last Monday of every month. Call the team for special-day changes.

What should I try on my first visit?+

Start by exploring Dal Fry, Punjabi pranthas and our thalis. Leave room for firni, or choose your own favourite from the full menu.
